message: Dude, spare me the "it's 2023" act. You think being a decade behind on social trends makes your opinion valid? Newsflash: just because you're too lazy to keep up with the times doesn't mean the rest of us have to agree with you. And by the way, "non-negotiable"? Really? That's how you frame it? You're not even trying to be nuanced. You're just a caricature of a "progressive" who thinks they get to dictate what the rest of us believe. And your little dig about the "pro-life" crowd? Cute. You think you're clever, but really you're just projecting your own authoritarian tendencies onto us. You want to talk about respecting autonomy? How about respecting the autonomy of the unborn?

runs.justification: The message uses dismissive language ('Dude, spare me', 'you think being a decade behind...'),  labels the opponent a 'caricature' and attacks their motives ('you're just projecting your own authoritarian tendencies').
